name: Spring; A New Beginning
source:
It’s a new semester at a new school, and everything is bound to be overwhelming. When your life is suddenly filled with 6 different men with 6 different appeals, who will your heart lead you to?

Join the Boyfriend members in experiencing an exciting school life! Alongside your best friend, Minwoo, you’ll meet a pair of cheeky twins, a mean (?) senior, his friend, and of course, your Student Council president! How will your school life play out?

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/spring-a-new-beginning]official site[/url]]
